name.zh: 凑到数量门槛，产出突然跃升
name.en: Reach a quantity threshold for a production jump

summary.zh: 临近门槛的最后几次投入，可能比平时更有价值。
summary.en: The final investments before a threshold may matter more than ordinary ones.

rules.zh: 购买或升级会增加数量，达到公开门槛时额外解锁速度或产量奖励。门槛之间的增幅较平缓，跨过门槛会出现一次跃升。玩家因此会比较离门槛的距离，而不只是比较当前单次购买回报。
rules.en: Purchases or levels increase a count. Reaching a visible threshold grants an extra speed or output bonus. Ordinary gains between thresholds are smoother, while crossing one creates a jump. Compare distance to the next threshold as well as immediate return.

loop.zh: 查看每项距离下一门槛多远
计算凑齐还需投入多少
loop.en: Estimate the cost to reach it
Complete one set or spread investment

loop.zh: 获得跃升后重排优先级

decisions.zh: 把钱投给当前效率最高的一项，还是补齐差一点就翻倍的另一项？
decisions.en: Buy the best current return or complete another item that is close to a multiplier?

decisions.zh: 为了全体达标奖励，是否值得补齐最弱的一项？
decisions.en: Is improving the weakest item worthwhile to earn an all-items threshold reward?

effect.zh: 间隔短形成频繁小目标；间隔长需要更明显的进度和下一次收益预告。
effect.en: Short intervals create frequent goals; long intervals need clear progress and reward previews.

effect.zh: 只奖励该项鼓励集中；全体达标奖励会拉动落后的项目。
effect.en: Local rewards encourage focus; all-items rewards give a reason to improve lagging projects.

contrast.zh: 点击英雄的节点主要改变特定英雄的伤害；冒险资本家的数量节点还能跨企业形成共同目标。
contrast.en: Clicker Heroes mainly changes a particular hero’s damage at thresholds; AdVenture Capitalist also uses counts to create goals across businesses.

combination.zh: 组合提案：三条产线都达到每轮5件时解锁整体速度奖励，玩家需要把原料从强线分给落后线。
combination.en: Design proposal: unlock a global speed reward when all three lines reach five items per round, encouraging material redistribution to lagging lines.

setup.zh: A生产器已有9台，凑10台会翻倍；B目前每台回报略高。
setup.en: Producer A has nine units and doubles at ten; B currently offers a slightly better per-unit return.

result.zh: A整组产出翻倍，超过刚才购买B的短期收益。
result.en: The whole A group doubles, outperforming the immediate B purchase.

next.zh: A的下一门槛较远，重新比较是否改买B。
next.en: A’s next threshold is distant, so reconsider buying B.

firstStep.zh: 做两类生产器，每类一个数量门槛，购买按钮显示距奖励还差几次。
firstStep.en: Build two producer types with one count threshold each; show purchases remaining to the reward.

pitfall.zh: 阈值奖励不能藏在长列表里，否则只剩盲目点购买。
pitfall.en: Do not bury threshold rewards in long lists or purchases become blind clicking.

test.zh: 接近不同门槛时，玩家是否改变购买对象？
test.en: Do players switch their purchase target as different thresholds approach?
